parameters.query:
SELECT
  d.doctor_id,
  d.doctor_name,
  d.department,
  d.specialization,
  d.consultation_duration,
  ds.day_of_week,
  ds.start_time,
  ds.end_time,
  ds.is_available
FROM doctors d
LEFT JOIN doctor_schedule ds
  ON d.doctor_id = ds.doctor_id
  AND ds.day_of_week = '{{ $json.day_of_week }}'
WHERE d.doctor_id = {{ $json.doctor_id }}
AND d.is_active = TRUE;
